description: Trigger evals for where-we-at: it audits a multi-slice task against its approved plan and reports done, missing and remaining, while its siblings close one slice, route one step, rebuild context, or repair artifact drift.

should_trigger: how far are we from done on this task?

IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md has six slices across two waves and I have lost track. Slices 01 to 03 are merged. Tell me what is finished, what is missing, and what still has to happen before this task is complete.
The backend repo is through slice 03 but the frontend repo has barely started. Give me a per-repo checkpoint against the approved plan so I can see who is ahead.

We have been on this for a week and two decisions changed midway. I do not trust my own picture of it, so assess where the task really stands versus the plan and the exit criteria, not just what TASK_STATE.md claims.
macro status please: what is done vs planned across all the phases?

should_not_trigger.prompt: Slice 04 is implemented and its tests pass. Can I close it, and does that finish the whole task or only this slice?
TASK_STATE.md is current and I trust it. Just tell me the single next step, which editor mode to use, and how heavy the work is.
New chat window, the transcript is gone. Rebuild what we were doing from TASK_STATE.md and the linked files so I can keep going from here.
TASK_STATE.md says slice 02 is in progress but IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md marks it done and the code has moved on since. Repair the disagreement between the artifacts.
I have eleven open tasks across three projects. Which one should I pick up first, and which are finished but never archived?
